title: juncus balticus f. pusillus
intro: Juncus balticus f. pusillus, commonly known as dwarf sand rush, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Juncaceae family. It is a small, perennial plant that grows in sandy areas and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The plant is said to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing inflammation and protecting against cell damage, and its therapeutic actions may include wound healing and antimicrobial activity. Bioactive constituents of Juncus balticus f. pusillus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
